title: Fixed Convex Shop Observation Mirror
description: One original static convex shop observation-mirror visual prop. A closed circular silver metallic-PBR body has a genuinely outward-bulging five-band faceted front and complete flat rear. A thick continuous orange protective rim seats around the full cylindrical edge. One integral compact rear standoff joins the back to a rectangular mounting plate. Three closed editable meshes and three opaque untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bounds-centred and lowest-rim Z datum for placement, not a floor-standing support. Newly authored convex wall-accessory construction, not the existing flat full-length floor mirror resized or recoloured. No host wall, screws, pivot, sensors, real-time reflection guarantee, optical field-of-view, coverage, mounting load or safety certification.
